method_notes: Every model answers the same state, the same rubric and the same exact label set.
Native adapters read the model's own probability distribution; LLM baselines verbalize one under a JSON schema. The two are labelled and never mixed silently.
Serial, one request at a time, no retries, no concurrency: latency includes the network from a Hetzner server in Germany.
Accuracy is argmax. Ordinal questions also report expected-value MAE.
Brier is the multi-class sum over the exact label set; ECE is top-label with 10 equal-width bins.
Confidence intervals resample whole scenarios, because paraphrases of one scenario are not independent.
A route with no billable account (a public demo, our own CPU, a flat-rate subscription) reports a null price, never a zero.
